critical_code_review_comments: Login.js: demo panel rendered twice in DOM (desktop + mobile) causing duplicate data-testid values. Not a bug per se but could confuse strict selectors; consider conditional rendering or unique testids per variant (e.g. demo-desktop-<email> / demo-mobile-<email>).

Login.js quickLogin uses stale `form` in setForm({...form, email, password}) but doesn't await state update before login — works because credentials are passed directly from `d`; still, the setForm call is essentially cosmetic and can be removed.
